verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a reasonable thing to ask of an incident-management platform, but no evidence shows Rootly offering bulk edit, bulk resolve, or batch actions across many incidents or alerts. Workflows, alert grouping and deduplication, the API, and the MCP server are related features or developer building blocks, not a documented bulk-operation capability, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
